screen: Deck's own screen (Quick Access window 854x454, dpr 1.5)

setup.model: qwen2.5vl:3b, 3.2 GB, the smallest tickable model (qwen3.5:4b is 3.4 GB). It is a vision model.
setup.textOrderRouteBlocked: The Set text model try order picker lists only one model (gemma4:e2b-it-qat; the embedding model is not listed), so no reorder can be made. Pressing Done with no change saves nothing: the file stayed []. The merge does nothing while the text list is empty, so the text-list half could not be set up. The vision list was already non-empty, so the vision half was tested instead.

pressed: RB to Ollama tab; Down x13 to Set text model try order, A, Down x2 to Done, A (no change written)
Walked to Browse models (Down/Up presses only), A; Down x5 to the tick row Select qwen2.5vl:3b to pull (star row Use gemma4 was passed over, never pressed); A once
Footer read Pull selected (1) 3.2 GB, toast 'Queued to pull', nothing downloading (Ollama blobs unchanged)
Down x2 to Pull selected, A. A box 'Turn on internet downloads?' appeared (Internet downloads was off in Permissions). Right, A on 'Turn on and download' (allowed by the session for this row)
B x5 from the Ollama tab: closed the panel, the side rail, then Steam's main menu opened, one more B closed it. Screenshot at 22:23 showed the panel gone. The panel was closed for the whole download.

seen.afterReopen: deck_openPlugin reported the panel already open with the ring on the tab bar; file read again at reopen time, unchanged (same two entries, none lost or duplicated).
seen.internet_downloads: changed false to true by the confirm box; a side effect of the row.

cleanup.modelRemoved: /home/deck/.local/bin/ollama rm qwen2.5vl:3b: deleted; ollama list back to nomic-embed-text:latest and gemma4:e2b-it-qat
cleanup.tryOrderReset: The vision picker shows only the installed model, and Done with no change writes nothing, so the stale qwen2.5vl:3b entry stayed in the file. Reset to defaults would give [] not the original ['gemma4:e2b-it-qat']. Restored the two changed keys by an SSH edit (vision_model_routing_order back to ['gemma4:e2b-it-qat'], capabilities.internet_downloads back to false) then reloaded the plugin at once. Whole file compared with the backup after: identical.
cleanup.note: A removed model's name stays in a saved try order until someone resets it. Not a fail; worth knowing.

verdict: PASS for the vision list (the picked model joined last, gemma4 kept, no duplicate, panel closed while the download ended, no reopen before the file was read). The text-list half is BLOCKED: the Deck has one answering model, so a saved text order cannot be made from the picker. Session to decide whether the vision result is enough.

newFinding.picker: The try-order pickers cannot save a one-model list, so on a Deck with one model there is no way to make a saved (non-automatic) order from the screen.
newFinding.staleName: A model removed from the Deck stays in the saved try order file.
